technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals in short-term timeframes (RSI14 rising, StochRSI cross-up, Supertrend) are offset by weakness in intermediate trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud) and volume confirmation issues (CMF negative, OBV not rising).

fundamental.summary: DTE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 99 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for DTE; congressional activity is stale (301+ days old), market sentiment is neutral with slight bearish bias, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (267.84) indicates extreme market stress; utilities defensive positioning offers limited protection in current environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (100.47) offers tactical entry for mean-reversion scalp in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate trend structure is broken (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud), macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional support, earnings 99 days out), and volume confirmation is missing—risk/reward heavily skewed to downside.
